correctness.rationale: For every finite normalized coordinate input, the disjoint output supports give the exact norm-power identity with coefficients lambda_n. A threshold t>sigma_j leaves fewer than j large input columns and gives all four upper bounds; j inputs with coefficient>s produce the lower bounds for a, b, c by elementary kernel/codimension counting. For d, the disjoint unit vectors lemma is proved from p-subadditivity and strictly column-dominant block-mass arrays: approximate representatives inside a subspace of dimension<j would have to be linearly independent. This argument works over both scalar fields for all 0<p<=1, handles nonattained ranks and zero coefficients and does not infer infinite statements from finite tests. Actual VERIFY.py produced 130 exact dominance profiles and 420 sampled fiber identities.

originality.rationale: The new equality simultaneously identifies approximation, Bernstein, Gelfand, and especially Kolmogorov numbers for all 0<p<=1 weighted coordinate quasi-Banach composition maps. Actual searches and full published source inspections located a four-number formula for C(K), Hilbert H2 approximation estimates, Banach Lp finite-fiber multiplication, and essential-norm results for the present quasi-Banach objects, but none has a demonstrated implication to nonlocally convex weighted sequence-space Kolmogorov widths. The new block-p-mass column-dominance lemma supplies the missing quotient-width inequality without range projection. Full-text access to the most plausible 2023 source remained incomplete and equivalent literature is a residual risk.

value.rationale: Beyond established boundedness and essential-norm criteria, the theorem specifies all four natural finite-index approximation and quotient-width invariants for every weighted symbol and weight sequence at nonlocally convex p. The key Kolmogorov statement is not a trivial Hilbert diagonal consequence: already a doubled normalized output vector in l_p^2 (p<1) has no norm-one linear projection. The strict column block-p-dominance lemma bridges that concrete structural obstacle and yields a genuine exact infinite sequence of invariants; compact/strict-singular equivalence is an immediate usable consequence. The scope is a natural full operator class, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
